newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent dips after neutral API data, NYMEX off.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent dips after neutral API data, NYMEX off.

text.p: Brent crude futures in Asia were slightly lower on Thursday in generally indecisive trade following neutral API data.
July Brent futures on SIMEX were last traded at $19.20 per barrel, down four cents from London, which overnight rose just two cents to settle at $19.24.
NYMEX futures meanwhile, trading on the ACCESS system, were last traded at $20.75, down four cents from New York.
"The market is undecided on where it is going," one broker said.
Overnight API data was considered neutral with both crude and distillate stocks rising more than had been expected, although gasoline fell more than had been expected.
Brokers said the crude build had just tipped the balance in the crude market, prompting the slight move lower.
However, they said the sentiment was unlikely to last long and players would look for other indications for market direction.
